description: This file defines Pydantic models (schemas) for workout-related entities in a gym management system, including exercises, templates, programs, and their associated components.

classes.name: ExerciseBase
classes.description: Base model for exercise data, including name, description, and category.

classes.name: ExerciseCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new exercise, inherits from ExerciseBase.

classes.name: ExerciseOut
classes.description: Model for outputting exercise data, includes id and ORM mode configuration.

classes.name: PaginatedExercises
classes.description: Model for paginated list of exercises.

classes.name: TemplateExerciseBase
classes.description: Base model for template exercises, including exercise ID, sets, reps, rest, and notes.

classes.name: TemplateExerciseCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a template exercise, inherits from TemplateExerciseBase.

classes.name: TemplateExerciseOut
classes.description: Model for outputting template exercise data, includes id, template_id, and ORM mode.

classes.name: WorkoutTemplateBase
classes.description: Base model for workout templates, including name and goal.

classes.name: WorkoutTemplateCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a workout template, includes optional exercises.

classes.name: WorkoutTemplateOut
classes.description: Model for outputting workout template data, includes id, trainer_id, and ORM mode.

classes.name: PaginatedTemplates
classes.description: Model for paginated list of workout templates.

classes.name: ProgramCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a workout program, including name, member user ID, optional template, and notes.

classes.name: ProgramOut
classes.description: Model for outputting program data, including id, name, member_user_id, trainer_id, and notes.

classes.name: PaginatedPrograms
classes.description: Model for paginated list of programs.

classes.name: ProgramDayCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a program day, including day index and name.

classes.name: ProgramDayOut
classes.description: Model for outputting program day data, including id, program_id, day_index, and name.

classes.name: PaginatedProgramDays
classes.description: Model for paginated list of program days.

classes.name: ProgramDayExerciseCreate
classes.description: Model for creating an exercise within a program day, including exercise_id, sets, reps, rest_seconds, and notes.

classes.name: ProgramDayExerciseOut
classes.description: Model for outputting exercise within a program day, includes id, program_day_id, and ORM mode.

classes.name: PaginatedProgramDayExercises
classes.description: Model for paginated list of exercises within a program day.
